projects.name: Jobsy REST API
projects.description: Marketplace platform connecting local service providers (plumbers, electricians, tutors) with clients. Complete system with manual provider verification, service management, booking system, reviews, geolocation, and real-time communication with WebSockets.
highlights: Provider verification system with document validation (ID, tax ID, CURP)
Role-based access control (USER, PROVIDER, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)
Booking system with availability management and status tracking
Geolocated provider search by category, distance, and rating
Real-time messaging with WebSockets between clients and providers
Dual notifications: in-app (WebSockets) and email for system events
Review and rating system for service transparency
